newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SFE wheat futures firm, trade in line with cash.
newsitem.headline: SFE wheat futures firm, trade in line with cash.

text.p: Australian wheat futures firmed on Monday, with January 1998 trading 50 cents higher to A$174.00 a tonne on four lots volume.
Most settlement prices in other contracts, which did not trade, rose by 50 cents to A$1.50.

Futures were in line with the cash market, with private traders quoting a price of A$168.00 a tonne delivered Newcastle for December/January. Cash prices require an additional A$5.00 for receival fees to reach an equivalent basis with futures.
Cash traders said business was more likely at the January contract's closing bid of A$172.00, or A$167.00 on a futures equivalent basis.
